name: Differentiable Volume Path Tracing with Delta Tracking
definition: A differentiable path tracer for participating media that uses delta tracking for volumetric scattering and handles surface interactions via BSDF sampling, accumulating gradients for emission, scattering, and extinction coefficients.
summary: Differentiable Volume Path Tracing with Delta Tracking is a differentiable path tracer for participating media that uses delta tracking to sample volumetric scattering and maintains separate gradient accumulators for emission, scattering, and extinction coefficients to enable inverse rendering optimization.
